name: layout14
description: Korean editorial scrapbook collage / Pinterest aesthetic moodboard. Soft ivory and warm cream base with black accent elements. Background is cream canvas with evenly spaced black polka dots and halftone dot gradient clusters in corners — however, if the outfit has a dominant motif (floral, plaid, animal print, etc.), replace the polka dot background pattern with a subtle version of that motif to create visual harmony between outfit and background (e.g. rose print outfit → soft rose pattern background; striped outfit → thin stripe texture; plain outfit → keep original polka dots). The layout contains 6 photo slots: one small portrait card upper-left layered over vintage postage paper scraps, one tilted polaroid portrait upper-right corner, two medium portraits side-by-side inside a large white social-media content card at center (resembling a Twitter/X or blog post card with 'user name here' placeholder text and social interaction icons), one small polaroid portrait lower-right, one oversized freeform cutout subject lower-left with hand-drawn doodle outline around the figure. Decorative elements include rose wax seal stamp (left side), vintage Fujifilm camera cutout (upper area), outline star sticker (upper-right), white gardenia flower cutout (right side and center), Miffy bunny plush cutout (lower-right corner), dashed curved line doodles in warm brown/taupe (scattered). Clean editorial styling, soft daylight photography, Korean Pinterest diary aesthetic. Follow the exact number, shape, scale hierarchy, overlap style, and arrangement of photo slots shown in the layout reference.
swipe_cta: Add a small paper label, social-media style tag, or doodle sticker containing a short swipe-related CTA (such as 'Swipe →' or a similar concise variation). Keep the wording minimal and elegant. Integrate it naturally with the stationery elements and background pattern while preserving the clean editorial aesthetic.
